desc_en: A single, coherent overnight build: one technician transforms an empty corner of a Skopje Old Bazaar warehouse into a finished exhibition stand, step-by-step—floor vinyl, wall panels, LED edge lighting—ending with a warm welcome. Grounded, Balkan-real textures, no stock look, no readable signage.
music: Upbeat modern phonk, heavy bass, fast hi-hats, 130 bpm
vo_mk: Од празен агол до готов штанд.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, top-down view of a bare concrete floor corner inside a Skopje Old Bazaar back-room workshop, rough plaster wall, a single work lamp casting warm tungsten light and hard shadows. One male technician (late 20s, short dark hair, black hoodie, dark jeans, clean sneakers) kneels with a matte black vinyl roll and a metal squeegee. 24mm lens, gritty neutral palette, photorealistic, no readable text.
shots.motion: He pulls the vinyl toward himself in one steady motion and presses it flat with the squeegee. Camera makes a slow, controlled overhead slide forward about 30 cm, staying centered on the seam.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, same room and corner, still top-down but slightly closer on hands and floor edge. The matte black vinyl now covers half the area; a clean straight seam runs along the wall line. The same technician in the same clothes aligns the vinyl to the corner using the squeegee and a small utility knife (blade implied, not emphasized). Warm tungsten pool of light, concrete texture visible, 35mm lens look, photorealistic, no text.
shots.motion: He trims the vinyl edge in one continuous cut and presses the edge down firmly. Camera performs a subtle clockwise arc of about 15 degrees, keeping his hands and the corner centered.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, eye-level medium shot in the same Skopje Old Bazaar workshop corner, showing the wall and floor meeting. The floor is now fully covered in matte black vinyl. The same technician lifts a light-gray modular wall panel and clicks it onto a hidden frame; a second identical panel leans nearby. Warm tungsten key light from one side, soft falloff, 28mm lens, realistic Balkan interior textures, photorealistic, no readable signage.
shots.motion: He snaps the panel into place with a firm push until it seats flush. Camera does a slow push-in about 40 cm, emphasizing the panel locking and the clean corner line.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, same angle and room, medium shot tighter on the finished wall corner. Two light-gray panels are now installed, seams clean. The same technician runs a flexible LED strip into a recessed edge channel; the strip begins to glow a soft warm-white, reflecting subtly on the matte black floor. One work lamp remains visible as a practical, night-time feel. 35mm lens, warm-neutral palette, photorealistic, no text.
shots.motion: He presses the LED strip along the channel in one continuous pass as the light turns on smoothly. Camera tilts up slightly from his hands to the glowing edge, keeping framing stable and believable.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, transform end frame matching Shot 3’s eye-level corner composition. The same workshop corner now reads as a finished mini-stand: matte black floor, clean modular wall, warm LED edge glow, one simple white counter placed in the corner. The same technician stands relaxed behind the counter, shoulders open, giving a small welcoming gesture toward camera. Warm tungsten mixed with LED, cozy premium finish, 28mm lens, photorealistic, no readable text.
shots.motion: He makes one clear welcoming hand gesture and holds the pose. Camera performs a gentle pull-back about 50 cm to reveal the completed corner and lighting in one smooth move.
shots.end_kf: Vertical 9:16, same room, same eye-level angle and corner composition as the start of this shot. Everything remains identical except the technician’s hand finishes lowering to a calm resting position on the counter; the warm LED edge stays steadily lit. Photorealistic, warm-neutral palette, no readable text.
